exposure: Embryo sac type cesarean scar pregnancy
outcome: Efficacy of HIFU in treating cesarean section scar pregnancy
Changes in blood flow resistance index (RI)
Changes in β-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG) levels
cohort: 46 patients with cesarean section scar pregnancy
finding: Doppler ultrasound showed that HIFU treatment for 4 weeks led to changes in the appearance of the pregnancy, increased RI levels, and decreased β-hCG levels in patients with cesarean section scar pregnancy.
